startupError.coreOutdated: Your agmsg CLI is out of date ({{installed}} < {{pinned}}) and may not work correctly with this app.

member.emptyState: No agents yet. Use the + button above to add one.

monitorTip.native: Self-monitoring — this type delivers agmsg messages on its own
monitorTip.app: App monitor — agmsg messages are injected into this pane's stdin

pane.swapTitle: Click, then click another pane in this tab to swap positions

composer.noAppUser: no app-user — add one to send/receive

leave.title: Remove {{name}}?
leave.body: This removes {{name}} from {{team}} and closes its pane if it's running. This can't be undone from here.

deleteTeam.title: Delete team '{{team}}'?
deleteTeam.body: This permanently deletes team '{{team}}': its configuration, roster, identity history, and per-agent runtime records. This cannot be undone. If it was connected to a remote, reconnecting later can bring it back.
deleteTeam.membersRemainBody: This team has {{count}} member(s). Remove them all from the team and delete it?

purgeMessages.title: Purge message history for team '{{team}}'?
purgeMessages.body: This permanently deletes all message history for team '{{team}}'; it cannot be restored.

newTeam.title: New team
newTeam.note: Creates the team and adds you as its app-user (the bottom chat box owner).

appUser.title: Add app-user (you)
appUser.note: The app-user is your identity in this team — the owner of the bottom chat box. One per team.

closeWindow.title: Close this tab?
closeWindow.body: This stops the agent(s) running here: {{names}}. This can't be undone.

closePane.title: Close {{name}}?
closePane.body: This stops {{name}}. This can't be undone.

pane.noOtherPanes: No other panes in this tab

nativeDialog.updateAvailableBody: {{name}} {{version}} is available. Install and restart now?

stage.emptyHint: Click a member on the left to start an agent.

addons.engineOff: Add-ons are not available on this computer yet. A safety check did not pass with this system's web engine. Your other features are not affected.

install.label: Add-on repository
install.later: Installing from GitHub isn't available in this build yet.

permission.messagesRead: Read messages of a team you choose
permission.filesRead: Read files in a folder you choose
permission.gitRead: Read git history and changes in that folder
permission.networkAny: Connect to any site on the internet

card.messagesWant: {{title}} wants to read messages of team {{team}}.
card.denied: {{path}} is on agmsg's list of protected locations (keys, credentials, browser data). Add-ons can't read it.

installError.repo_not_found: Couldn't find github.com/{{owner}}/{{repo}}. Check the name. Private repositories aren't supported yet.
installError.ref_not_found: {{repo}} has no branch, tag or commit named {{ref}}.
installError.no_app_panes: {{repo}} has no app add-on (no app-panes/ folder). If it is an agmsg CLI plugin, it is installed from the CLI, not here.
installError.entry_missing: app-panes/{{pane}}/web/{{entry}} is missing. Add-ons must commit their built web/ folder.
installError.min_app: Needs agmsg app {{minApp}} or newer; this is {{appVersion}}.
installError.protocol_unknown: Made for a newer app (protocol {{protocol}}). Update the app to use it.
installError.too_large: Too large to install: {{measured}} (limit {{limit}}). Largest file: {{largest}}.

unsafe_entry.symlink: Refused: the repository contains a symbolic link at {{path}}. Add-ons may contain only plain files.
unsafe_entry.hardlink: Refused: the repository contains a hard link at {{path}}. Add-ons may contain only plain files.
unsafe_entry.outside_path: Refused: the repository contains a path outside the folder at {{path}}. Add-ons may contain only plain files.
unsafe_entry.reserved_name: Refused: the repository contains a reserved file name at {{path}}. Add-ons may contain only plain files.

installError.rate_limited: GitHub limits unauthenticated downloads; try again after {{time}}.

failure.digest_mismatch: {{title}} can't open: its files are incomplete or were changed after install.
failure.init_too_large: {{title}} was given more than it can take at once (the starting data is too large).

confirm.sends: It can send what it reads to {{hosts}}.
confirm.sendsAny: It can send what it reads to any site on the internet.
confirm.never: It can never: run programs, use the app's controls, or read anything you have not chosen.
confirm.noReview: agmsg does not review or sign add-ons. Install only from people you trust.
confirm.asksAgain: This update changes what the add-on can do. Permissions it had for the changed items will be asked again.

remove.title: Remove {{title}}?
remove.body: Closes its {{count}} open panes, deletes its files, and forgets every permission you gave it.

status.bad_requester: The sender does not match the requester.

note.other_machine: Control requests from other machines are not shown.

reason.extra_content: there is extra text after the JSON line
reason.too_large: the JSON line is over 2 KB
reason.bad_json: the JSON line is not valid JSON
reason.bad_shape: the request has the wrong shape
reason.bad_arg_value: an argument value is not text
reason.bad_requester: the requester is missing or malformed
